other.penalty:
Either way

Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or fine. Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and/or fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2002; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 24(F1)(a) and (G1) of the Immigration Act 1971 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limits for prosecutions:
None
